match_stages.stage_briefing:
*This is currently a USPSA Provisional Classification Stage*

Written Stage 
BriefingCM 26-03 Mike Who? is a 10 round, 50 point Comstock Classifier course. 
There are 5 USPSA targets.The best 2 hits per target will score. 
The start signal is audible.

The Handgun Start Position is standing anywhere inside of the shooting area. 
Handgun is loaded andholstered with wrists below belt.

The PCC Start Position is standing anywhere inside of the shooting area. 
Carbine is loaded with stocktouching belt.

The Make Ready position is at the start position.

On the start signal, engage the targets from the shooting area.
